name: Kakdichi Amti (Indian Cooked Cucumbers in Coconut-Tamarind Sauce)

ingredients.name: green bird's eye chilis, thinly sliced
long-grain fragrant rice, such as basmati or jasmine

instructions.primary_message: To Soften the Tamarind: In a small bowl, break tamarind into small pieces by hand. Pour 1/4 cup hot water over tamarind and set aside.
For the Coconut-Spice Paste: In a spice grinder, combine rice, coriander seeds, mustard seeds, and turmeric and grind into a very fine powder, 1 to 2 minutes.

Transfer spice powder to a blender. Add coconut and 1/2 cup water. Blend on high speed until mostly smooth, 1 1/2 to 2 minutes, stopping to scrape down the sides of the blender as needed. (If mixture does not blend easily, add more water, 2 tablespoons at a time, and continue blending until blended until the mixture is smooth and saucy.)

Transfer coconut-spice paste to a small bowl. Add 6 tablespoons water to the now-empty blender and briefly swirl to loosen any remaining paste. Add this liquid to the coconut-spice paste and set aside.

For the Tamarind Mixture: Set a fine-mesh strainer over a medium bowl. Using a fork, mash the now-softened tamarind into the soaking water. Strain tamarind-water mixture through fine-mesh strainer, using a flexible rubber spatula to push mixture through; discard any solids. Set aside.
To Cook the Cucumbers: In a medium saucepan, heat ghee over medium until shimmering. Reduce heat to low. Add chiles and cook, stirring frequently, until fragrant, about 30 seconds.

Increase heat to medium-high and add cucumbers, salt, and 6 tablespoons cold or room temperature water. Bring to a simmer and cook, uncovered, stirring occasionally, until cucumbers are just tender but still crisp, about 3 minutes.

Reduce heat to medium-low. Stir in sugar, reserved coconut-spice paste, and reserved tamarind mixture. Cook, stirring gently, just until the sauce is heated through and the cucumbers are coated, 1 to 2 minutes. (Do not allow the sauce to boil.)
Off heat, season with salt to taste. Serve with rice or bread on the side.

schema_metadata.keywords: cucumbers, cooked cucumbers, indian, indian dishes

description: This light cucumber stew combines coconut, tamarind, and green chiles for a tangy, richly flavored dish with crisp-tender cucumbers and a lightly thickened sauce.
notes:
Optional or for serving: Rice or bread, for serving

Optional substitutions: cold temperature water → room temperature water

Notes: If using frozen shredded coconut, thaw according to package instructions before using.
author: Kaumudi Marathé
